name: done-means-done
implementation: Consolidated protocol and newly integrated Python runtime based on the inspected source design. Not a byte-identical upstream checkout; baseline source was read through the GitHub connector. 0.4.0 additionally diverges from the inspected commit with locally reviewed defect fixes (acceptance-basis attestation, state-path canonicalization, background-holder execution, record supersession, history append, approval and listing diagnostics) that were not upstreamed. 0.4.1 adds bounded lock retry, tolerant bookkeeping hooks and sibling-worktree diagnostics. 0.5.0 binds evidence to each check's own candidate tree, diffs drift into a STALE result, runs a check list in one fingerprint window, refuses concurrent writers before running, serializes named resources across tasks, adds per-group listing, and makes recovery inspect the runner. No remote repository writes performed.
